scope: Local Chromium proof of the isolated Advantage Games /qc action surface only.
command: CI=true pnpm --filter vocabulary-games exec playwright test tests/e2e/qc/existing-action-cartridges.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1

assertions: Each title loads only from the Advantage Games /qc registry.
Keyboard, pointer, and touch events increment only native-input evidence counters.
Responsive compact and wide profiles preserve the persistent canvas and report no geometry issues.
Every interaction leaves progression at zero and completion emissions at zero.

disclosures: This is not a production catalog, Reading host, Primary host, completion persistence, migration, cutover, retirement, or deployment proof.
Historical and unknown source claims are intentionally rejected as progression rules; the test does not claim that historical mechanics currently run.
The evidence records browser-native input wiring only and does not validate real gameplay completion.
